name: @via-vitae/docs
description: ViaVitae documentation hub — Hugo + Doks, multilingual LT/EN/RU.

scripts.check:all: npm run lint:md && npm run check:frontmatter && npm run check:i18n && npm run check:links && npm run check:pii
scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p themes && rm -rf themes/doks && cp -r node_modules/@thulite/doks-core themes/doks && find themes/doks/layouts -type d -name "_partials" -exec sh -c 'for d; do mv "$d" "${d%_partials}partials"; done' _ {} + && find themes/doks/layouts -type d -name "_shortcodes" -exec sh -c 'for d; do mv "$d" "${d%_shortcodes}shortcodes"; done' _ {} + && printf '{{- $classes := slice }}{{- if site.Params.doks.scrollSpy }}{{- $classes = $classes | append "smooth-scroll" }}{{- end }}{{- .Scratch.Set "class" $classes }}' > themes/doks/layouts/partials/head/body-class.html && echo "{{- /* custom script footer stub */ -}}" > themes/doks/layouts/partials/footer/script-footer-custom.html && echo "// custom js stub" > themes/doks/assets/js/custom.js && sed -i "s|import '@thulite/core/assets/js/core.js';|// & // Disabled: dependency not available|" themes/doks/assets/js/app.js
